name: Daranna Gwal
description: Honored cenn of Dundoolin when the Belltower crumbled; named Hyal her heir and died.

timeline.summary: Injured Daranna is unable to stop delirious boggarts from destroying the Belltower, though she slays the warren's Auntie.
timeline.quote: Although she slew the warren's Auntie, she lost pride in her leadership

timeline.summary: Daranna names Hyal Lwellen her heir, wills him her sword, and dies.
timeline.quote: she named Hyal Lwellen her heir, willed him her precious sword, and died soon after
